title: Numerals 5: When the Number Itself Declines
description: In any case other than the nominative (dative, instrumental, prepositional) the numeral two, three, four, five takes its own case ending: к двум, с тремя, о пяти. Learn the forms with concrete everyday frames.
descriptionRussian: В косвенных падежах (дательном, творительном, предложном) само числительное два, три, четыре, пять получает падежное окончание: к двум, с тремя, о пяти. Учим формы на простых бытовых примерах.
intro: Everything so far assumed the number phrase was a subject or an object. When it is not, the number itself has to decline, which is the genuinely new content of this book. Both halves move: the number takes a case ending and the noun takes a matching plural one. Five declines like a soft feminine noun, which is a strange fact and a useful one.
rules: When the whole number-phrase is in a case other than the nominative (dative, instrumental, prepositional), the NUMBER declines too. It is no longer frozen in its dictionary shape.
Два/две: dative двум, instrumental двумя, prepositional (о) двух. Три: трём, тремя, (о) трёх. Четыре: четырём, четырьмя, (о) четырёх.
Пять declines like the soft feminine noun дверь: пять / пяти / пятью / пяти. The dative, instrumental, and prepositional are пяти, пятью, пяти.
Both parts agree: the number takes its case ending AND the noun takes the matching plural ending: к двум часам, с тремя друзьями, о пяти книгах.
Common triggers: к + dative (к двум часам), с + instrumental (с тремя друзьями), о/в/на + prepositional (о пяти книгах).
examples: Приходи к двум часам. (Come by two o'clock.) к + dative: двум часам.
Я пришёл к трём друзьям. (I came to three friends.) к + dative: трём друзьям.
Ольга гуляет с двумя братьями. (Olga is walking with two brothers.) с + instrumental: двумя братьями.
Мы поговорили с тремя соседями. (We talked with three neighbours.) с + instrumental: тремя соседями.
Он заплатил пятью рублями. (He paid with five roubles.) с-less instrumental of means: пятью рублями.
Учитель рассказал о двух книгах. (The teacher told us about two books.) о + prepositional: двух книгах.
В четырёх комнатах было тихо. (It was quiet in four rooms.) в + prepositional: четырёх комнатах.
Мы говорили о пяти учениках. (We talked about five pupils.) о + prepositional: пяти учениках.

items.hint: к asks for the dative. What is the dative of два?
items.explanation: The preposition к governs the dative. The dative of два/две is двум, and the noun matches: к двум часам.

items.promptEnglish: Olga is walking with two brothers.
items.explanation: С + instrumental = 'together with.' The instrumental of два is двумя, paired with the instrumental plural noun: с двумя братьями.

items.promptEnglish: The teacher told us about two books.
items.explanation: О governs the prepositional case. The prepositional of два/две is двух, with the noun in the prepositional plural: о двух книгах.

items.hint: с + instrumental again. The instrumental of три ends in -емя.
items.explanation: С takes the instrumental, and the instrumental of три is тремя: с тремя соседями. Compare двумя (from два): both take the instrumental -мя shape.

items.promptEnglish: It was quiet in four rooms.
items.hint: в ('in') here answers 'where?', so it takes the prepositional.
items.explanation: В answering 'where?' governs the prepositional. The prepositional of четыре is четырёх: в четырёх комнатах.

items.hint: о + prepositional. Пять declines like дверь.
items.explanation: О governs the prepositional. Пять follows soft feminine -ь nouns like дверь, so its prepositional is пяти: о пяти учениках.

blanks: Я приду к _____ часам. (I will come by three o'clock.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: К governs the dative. The dative of три is трём, and the noun matches in the dative plural: к трём часам.

errorCorrection.explanation: When the whole phrase is in a case other than the nominative, the number declines along with the noun. К takes the dative, so друзья becomes друзьям and три must become трём: к трём друзьям.
С takes the instrumental, so the number declines with its noun: с четырьмя подругами. Четыре is the bare nominative-accusative and cannot stand after с.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: We were thinking about six questions.
errorCorrection.explanation: After о the phrase is prepositional, so the number declines: о шести вопросах. Шесть is the nominative-accusative form, correct in 'мы видим шесть вопросов' but not after о.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I walked up to four windows (к + dative).
minimalPairs.explanation: К always governs the dative, and the dative of четыре is четырём: к четырём окнам. Четырьмя is the instrumental (used after с), so it would not fit after к.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He came with four children (с + instrumental).
minimalPairs.explanation: С meaning 'together with' takes the instrumental, and the instrumental of четыре is четырьмя: с четырьмя детьми. Четырём is the dative (used after к), the wrong case here.

hints: к + dative; пять declines like дверь
с + instrumental; ends in -ью like дверью
о + prepositional; same as the dative form

reviewVocab.definition: by two o'clock; к + dative, so the number becomes двум and the noun matches (часам).
with three friends; с ('together with') + instrumental, so три becomes тремя and the noun is in the instrumental plural.
пять declines like the soft feminine noun дверь: пять / пяти / пятью / пяти. This pattern covers 5-20 and 30.
